{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm the transformation
print("First 5 cleaned revenue values:", sales['revenue_clean'].head().tolist())

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Number of refunded orders:", len(refunded))

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue_completed}")"}
